title: S138 later notes: owner-wait rows and pane wording

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Later notes from the S138 relay (run-20261026-175512-e95d, landed 34bb9f8), not fixed in that slice:
- The pane could replace "last heard" with "waiting since HH:MM" for awaiting-approval and paused (owner: dim it now, this later).
- "awaiting approval  19h00m  owner approval" repeats the word approval; hide the Wait text when it only restates the state (`internal/tui/overview.go` showsWait).
- "2 of 6 steps running" on an awaiting-approval row reads as active work; say "2 of 6 steps" for owner-wait states.
- While awaiting approval, the pane's stage bar and its "waiting" tail animate as if live (`internal/tui/relayboard.go`, boardLive); decide whether an owner wait should animate.
- Trial wall clock 45 min, 1 fix round.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Owner picks at preflight for the animation and the "waiting since" line; the two wording notes are fixes. Tests first. UI slice: UI pass per rule u10.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- go test ./internal/tui -update, then review the golden diff
- slicer check
